了解这个项目，先和我确定第一层架构。: Get to know this project. Let's agree on the first layer of its architecture.
先确认项目记录语言。: Confirm the language for project records first.

语言确认后，再逐层建图: Choose a language, then map each layer
Agent 提出第一层候选，你来确认；不会直接锁定整棵架构树。: The agent proposes first-layer modules for you to review. It does not lock in the entire architecture at once.
继续这个项目。先回顾上次进度、未完成事项和下一步。: Continue this project. First review our progress, unfinished work and next steps.
只读最近记录，再按需打开命中项。: Read recent records, then open relevant entries as needed.
上次已确认四个第一层模块，并在“工作台”留下了职责边界和下一步。接下来先讨论工作: We agreed on four first-layer modules and saved the Workbench scope and next step. Next, let's discuss the Workbench's second layer and confirm it together.
先查小索引，再读命中的记录；不需要加载全部聊天历史。: Check the small index, then read the relevant records. There is no need to load the entire chat history.
描述现象，保留排查依据: Describe the issue and keep the evidence
切换模块后内容没有更新。先记录这个问题，再查已有坏例和相关模块，确认复现后排查。: The content doesn't update after switching modules. Record the issue, check past lessons and related modules, then reproduce it before investigating.
先记录已报告的现象，原因待确认。: Record the reported behavior. The cause is still unconfirmed.
先把切换后的异常记为坏例，原因标为待确认。接着检索已有经验、定位相关模块，再复现: I'll record the switching issue with its cause unconfirmed. Next: check past lessons, find the relevant modules, reproduce the issue, then fix and verify it.
问题有记录，排查有来路: Keep the issue and the investigation together
工作台可查看、关联和处理 Bug 条目；勾选状态不等于代码已经修复。: Use the workbench to inspect, link and manage bug records. A checked status does not mean the code has been fixed.
已设为中文，后续沿用这个项目的记录语言。接下来可以打开工作台，一起讨论第一层。: English is set as this project's record language. We can now open the workbench and discuss the first layer.
打开当前项目的工作台。: Open the workbench for this project.
工作台已准备好。先打开它；第一层还没有确认，画布从项目根节点开始。: The workbench is ready. Open it to start from the project root; the first layer is not confirmed yet.
检查当前项目与本次会话的工作台地址。: Check the workbench address for this project and session.
先按开工面划分第一层，给我候选，我来选。: Group the first layer by areas of work. Suggest candidates and let me choose.

I suggest four modules:
Workbench — where you and the agent collaborate
Cold start — installation and setup
Project files — records and indexes
hook — session start and end

Confirm this layer before we discuss the next.
候选已整理到第一层选择视图，尚未锁定。: Candidates are ready in the first-layer view. Nothing is locked in yet.
好，下次从工作台的第二层继续。: Great. Next time, let's continue with the Workbench's second layer.
已记录：第一层四个模块已确认，工作台的职责边界和下一步都留在地图中。下次回到这个: Recorded: four first-layer modules are confirmed. The Workbench scope and next step are saved on the map. Next session, we'll read recent records and continue with layer two.
本次进度与下一步已记录。: Progress and next steps have been recorded.
说明需求，确认记录语言: Describe the task and choose a record language
示例用户回复，再记录偏好: The demo user replies, then the preference is saved
从当前客户端继续打开工作台: Continue into the workbench from this client
从会话进入项目画布: Go from the conversation to the project canvas
工作台已打开，第一层待讨论: The workbench is open; layer one is ready to discuss
先给候选，不直接生成整棵树: Review candidates before building the tree
挑选主干，定稿后加入: Choose the modules, confirm, then add them
在刚确认的模块继续协作: Continue working inside the confirmed module
工作台已打开。先回到对话，一起讨论第一层。: The workbench is open. Return to the conversation to discuss layer one.
打开刚才讨论的第一层候选。: Open the first-layer candidates you just discussed.
示例用户逐张选择工作台、冷启动、底层文件系统和 hook。: The demo user selects Workbench, Cold start, Project files and hook.
定稿后确认加入；第一层由人锁定。: Confirm and add the modules. You decide the first layer.
进入刚刚建好的“工作台”模块。: Enter the Workbench module you just added.
把本次确定的边界，留在这个模块。: Save the agreed scope on this module.
记下下一步：只细化工作台的第二层。: Save the next step: refine the Workbench's second layer.
再回来，决定和下一步仍在。后续会话从这里接上。: Your decision and next step are still here. The next session starts from this context.
从一张地图，看清项目。: See the project on one map.
进入模块，找到相关记忆。: Enter a module to find its context.
继续下钻，定位开工的位置。: Go deeper to find where to start.
沿面包屑，回到全局。: Follow the breadcrumbs back to the overview.
决定和想法，跟着模块走。: Keep decisions and ideas with their module.
在原位写下这一次的决定。: Write this decision right where it belongs.
留下一个下次可以继续的想法。: Leave an idea for the next session.
再回来，记录还在这里。: Come back to find your records here.
点选模块，突出生产与消费关系。: Select a module to highlight what it produces and consumes.
确认关联，再进入模块。: Check the connections, then enter the module.
从第一层开始，和 Agent 一起划分。: Work with the agent to define the first layer.
候选摆在画布上，等待你的选择。: Candidates wait on the canvas for your review.
逐个选入四张主干卡片。: Select four module cards, one at a time.
通过校验，确认这一层。: Pass validation and confirm the layer.
先看职责，再决定是否加入。: Review its purpose before adding it.
加入工作台，进入下一层。: Add Workbench and enter the next layer.
暂不需要的提议，收进已取消。: Move an unwanted proposal to Cancelled.
看清本次会话的工作范围。: See the scope of this session.
再次点选，收回这个范围。: Click again to remove it from the scope.
沿链路定位到所属模块。: Follow the path to its module.
徽章和色点标出谁在处理、卡在哪一步。: The badge and colored dot show who is handling it, and where it is stuck.
在模块里查看问题条目。: Read the issue inside its module.
勾选后进入原型的沉淀状态。: Checking it starts the prototype's settling state.
转为休眠条目，等待下一次检索。: The record becomes dormant until it is relevant again.

下一步：先讨论工作台的第二层，再逐层确认。: Next: discuss the Workbench's second layer, then confirm each layer together.
